description: Create a new appointment group (Canvas Scheduler sign-up slots) in one or more contexts, e.g. ["course_123"], and return the created group object (id, title, workflow_state, context_codes). New groups start workflow_state "pending" (unpublished, invisible to participants) unless publish=true — once published, Canvas will not let it go back to unpublished, so confirm with get_appointment_group before setting it. participant_visibility defaults to "private"; set it to "protected" so signed-up participants can see each other's sign-ups. Add new_appointments as [start_at, end_at] ISO 8601 pairs to create the bookable time slots up front, or add more later with update_appointment_group. Each call creates another group — there is no dedup against an existing title. Requires permission to manage the Scheduler in every context listed.

context_codes.description: Contexts to associate with this group, e.g. ["course_123"]

max_appointments_per_participant.description: Maximum time slots each participant can reserve

min_appointments_per_participant.description: Minimum time slots each participant must reserve

new_appointments.description: Time slots to create as [start_at, end_at] pairs (ISO 8601 strings)

participant_type.description: Whether individuals (User) or groups (Group) sign up. Default: User

participant_visibility.description: Who can see other sign-ups: "private" (instructors only) or "protected" (all participants)

publish.description: If true, publish immediately (default: false = draft)

name: create_appointment_group
title: Create Appointment Group
